name: Writely
summary: A browser extension that brings AI writing help to editors on any web page. It uses OpenAI's GPT models to draft text such as emails and articles, and it can also help with translation and reading. It is positioned as an alternative to Notion AI.
audience: People who write emails, posts or replies in the browser and want AI drafting help outside of a dedicated writing app.
pros: Works on editors across many web pages, not one site
Covers writing, translation and reading assistance
Also offered for Firefox and Edge
cons: Needs your own OpenAI API key, which you set up in the settings
Relies on a third-party AI service
